name: 30232-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16: a 32-block vision tower (patch 14, 2x2 spatial merge) in front of a 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads). Ungated, ~16 GB of weights; full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=2, bounded at 200 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, the first 20% discarded as warmup, so ~160 requests reach the aggregate.
workload: Single-turn image+text: ONE 1568x1568 JPEG (guidellm `synthetic_image`, content `gradient`, quality 85, seed 30232) and a pinned 64-token question per request, 8 output tokens, temperature 0. Every request carries different pixels. 1568 is a multiple of 28 and 1568x1568 px sits inside the processor's own min/max pixel band, so smart_resize neither scales nor pads: 12544 patch positions, 3136 prompt tokens after the 2x2 merge.
purpose: A 7-billion-parameter photo question-answering assistant for two concurrent users sending one large image and a brief question on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit cd00c443d2272e5325dc6d730616f0a68ad533d1. The load is not in
# this file: it is scenario.json's `streams`. Nothing here is searched or tuned.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# Must match scenario.json's `images_per_request: 1`: it is both the admission limit and what the
# start-up profiling pass is sized against. Change one and you must change the other.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1, "video": 0}

mm-encoder-attn-backend: TORCH_SDPA
enable-prefix-caching: false
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
distributed-executor-backend: uni
tensor-parallel-size: 1
